svg.aria-label: A hand-drawn crayon cartoon title card for Akansha Mishra: a smiling sun, drifting clouds, a looping paper plane, a waving robot, books, a medal and a microphone. Tagline: demos are easy; she builds the AI that survives the real world. Rolling end credits: B.Tech CSE (AI) at IGDTUW, CGPA 8.69, class of 2028; winner of BHASHINI VYOMA 2026 with 10 lakh rupees prize money and a 2 lakh grant; featured by PIB; Top 10 with special mention at Paytm Build for AI; three hackathon wins; TEDx IGDTUW top 7; 2nd at JAM Extempore, DU; deep learning intern at Anveshan Foundation; Spark Fellowship 2026.
